topics.title: Armenian Foreign Minister Visits Estonia
topics.text: Ararat Mirzoyan is scheduled to pay a working visit to Estonia. The trip underscores ongoing diplomatic engagement between Yerevan and Tallinn.

topics.text: CivilNet examines why Armenia needs to rethink voting rights for its diaspora. The analysis comes amid broader discussions on constitutional reforms and opposition strategies.

topics.title: Azerbaijani and Turkish Leaders Meet in Shushi
topics.text: Ilham Aliyev and Recep Tayyip Erdogan held a meeting in Shushi, referred to as Azerbaijan-occupied Nagorno-Karabakh by the source. Aliyev also marked the sixth anniversary of the Azerbaijani takeover of Karabakh with remarks referencing 'war criminals'.

sources.title: Aliyev, Erdogan meet in Azerbaijan-occupied Nagorno-Karabakh’s Shushi

topics.title: Pashinyan Offers Condolences for Krakow Shooting
topics.text: Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan expressed condolences following a deadly shooting incident in Krakow, Poland. The gesture was reported by Armenpress.
